state:
**Goal `html-later` — Stage 2 is under way: `Core\Html::later` runs on a normal route.** ADR 0266 decides the goal and `rule:core-classes/html-later` is still `designed`. `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs` holds the slots (`Ctx::register_later`, the per-request 96-bit token, the placeholder bytes) and `run_later`, the one assembly pass, which `nvs_host::isolate` calls on both completion paths right after the program returns. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/html.rs` has the `later` row and member: a registration under the HTML sink, the closure run in place anywhere else. `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/html_later.rs` holds 10 of the stage check's 13 tests, all green.

**Known gap, recorded in `later.rs`'s module doc:** slots run when the frame returns, concurrently with each other but not with the main script, because the host seam has no "start a child and return" call. The goal's "starts `fn` at once" needs one; see Backlog. A `later` called inside a `Core\Task::all` child registers on the child's context, and nothing assembles it.

Still owed for the stage: the head rule, the limit tests, the two `.nvst` cases, the rule flip. `docs/reference/lang/80-concurrency.md:10-13` and `docs/spec/02-php-migration.md:862` still need rewriting (goal § Stage 0).

items.text: **The head rule and the limits**: a `later` slot's context is marked (set it where `later.rs`'s `fill` starts the inner group), and a status, header, redirect, body method, cookie or session regeneration on it throws `LogicError` (`rule:core-classes/html-later`); tests `a_later_closure_that_changes_the_response_head_throws`, `later_tasks_share_the_requests_limits` and `a_limit_breach_fails_the_whole_request_on_a_normal_route` in the test file — `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs:274`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs:1`, `crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/isolate.rs:296`.

**The two `.nvst` cases** of check `later-assembles-a-page-and-refuses-a-head-change`: the page case needs a request-mode runner (find how `tests/conformance/` runs a case under the HTML sink), and the reject case needs a checker diagnostic for a head-changing call inside a `later` closure — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/html.rs:186`.

**Flip `rule:core-classes/html-later` to `shipped`** with `guardedBy` naming `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/html_later.rs` and the two cases, and rewrite the two docs Stage 0 names — `docs/reference/lang/80-concurrency.md:10`.

backlog: A host call that starts a closure task and returns, so a slot overlaps the main script, as the rule says (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/host.rs:613`, the `Host` trait). Without it a slot starts when the frame returns.
A `later` inside a `Core\Task::all` child: its slot should move to the request's slots when the child ends (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs`).
Stage 3, slotted delivery: `#[Core\Route(slotted: true)]`, `Core\Response::slotted()`, the polyfill, the browser lane.
Stage 4: LSP completion and hover for `later`'s options.
